segments.en: Four lines of code. 101 trips to the database.

segments.en: EncoreCai built a “This week's concerts” page: list the concerts, show each venue's name. It looks perfect with 5 test concerts. With real data it's slow, and at busy times other pages start failing with “timed out waiting for a database connection”.
segments.zh: EncoreCai 做了一個「本週演唱會」頁面：列出演唱會，並顯示每個場館的名稱。用 5 場測試資料時看起來完美。換成真實資料就變慢了，忙碌時段其他頁面還開始出現「等待資料庫連線逾時」的錯誤。

一句話說清楚 N+1

segments.en: 1 query to get the list, then N more, one per item, usually hidden inside a loop or an ORM's lazy loading. Fetch related data in bulk instead.
segments.zh: 1 次查詢取得清單，接著每個項目再查 N 次，通常藏在迴圈或 ORM 的延遲載入（lazy loading）裡。改成一次批次抓取相關資料。
實驗室 · 連線池
連線池大小 10

segments.en: Every query needs a connection. There aren't many.
segments.zh: 每次查詢都需要一條連線，而連線不多。

segments.en: Opening a database connection is slow (about 30 ms here: network handshake, login, setup). Encore's database plan also allows only 20 connections in total. A connection pool opens a few connections once and lends them out. A request borrows one, runs its queries, and gives it back. If none are free, the request waits.
segments.zh: 開一條資料庫連線很慢（這裡大約 30 毫秒：網路交握、登入、初始化）。Encore 的資料庫方案總共也只允許 20 條連線。連線池（connection pool）會先開好幾條連線，再借給大家用。請求借一條、跑完查詢、再還回去。沒有空閒的連線時，請求就得等。

關鍵差別

segments.en: Without a pool, every request opens its own connection: slow, and a traffic spike blows past the database's limit. With a pool, requests borrow from a fixed set: fast, and the database is protected. When the pool runs out, requests wait their turn.
segments.zh: 沒有連線池時，每個請求都自己開一條連線：很慢，而且流量尖峰會衝破資料庫的上限。有連線池時，請求從固定的一組連線中借用：很快，資料庫也受到保護。連線池用完時，請求就排隊等輪到自己。

問題
N+1 查詢

segments.en: One query for the list, plus one per item. Invisible with test data, painful with real data. Look for queries inside loops.
segments.zh: 清單一次查詢，加上每個項目各一次。測試資料看不出來，真實資料很痛。留意迴圈裡的查詢。
解法
批次抓取

segments.en: A JOIN, or the ORM's eager loading (include, select_related, includes). 2 queries instead of 101.
segments.zh: 用 JOIN，或 ORM 的預先載入（eager loading：include、select_related、includes）。2 次查詢取代 101 次。
防護
連線池

segments.en: Reuse a fixed set of open connections. Faster requests, and the database never sees more connections than it can handle.
segments.zh: 重複使用一組固定的開啟連線。請求更快，資料庫也永遠不會收到超出它負荷的連線數。
取捨

segments.en: A bigger pool lets more requests run at once, but it can't go past what the database allows, and every app server has its own pool. Fix slow queries first: they hold connections longer and drain the pool.
segments.zh: 連線池越大，能同時跑的請求越多，但不能超過資料庫允許的數量，而且每台應用伺服器都有自己的連線池。先修慢查詢：它們會佔住連線更久，把連線池耗光。
考考自己

segments.en: `concerts = SELECT * FROM concerts LIMIT ${n};\nfor (c of concerts)\n  c.venue = SELECT * FROM venues WHERE id = c.venue_id;`

segments.zh: '預先載入'

segments.en: `concerts = SELECT * FROM concerts LIMIT ${n};\nvenues   = SELECT * FROM venues WHERE id IN (…${n} ids…);`
`SELECT concerts.*, venues.name\nFROM concerts JOIN venues ON venues.id = concerts.venue_id\nLIMIT ${n};`
`SELECT * FROM venues WHERE id = ${101 + i}   -- ${VENUES[i % VENUES.length]}`
`SELECT * FROM venues WHERE id IN (101, 102, … ${100 + n})`
`SELECT concerts.*, venues.name FROM concerts JOIN venues … LIMIT ${n}`

segments.zh: `     …還有 ${lines.length - 13} 條類似的…`
' 毫秒'

segments.en: `✕ ${q} queries for one page, ${X.fmt(ms)} ms of waiting on the database. Each one is fast. There are just too many, and the count grows with the page.`
segments.zh: `✕ 一個頁面 ${q} 次查詢，在資料庫上等了 ${X.fmt(ms)} 毫秒。每一次都很快，只是次數太多，而且會隨頁面內容增加。`

segments.en: `✓ ${q} ${q === 1 ? 'query' : 'queries'}, ${X.fmt(ms)} ms. Same page, same data, and the count stays the same at 5 concerts or 500.`
segments.zh: `✓ ${q} 次查詢，${X.fmt(ms)} 毫秒。同一個頁面、同一份資料，不管 5 場還是 500 場演唱會，查詢次數都一樣。`

segments.en: 'Press Play with the N+1 pattern, a pool of 10, and 40 page loads/second.'
segments.zh: '用 N+1 模式、連線池 10、每秒 40 次頁面載入，按播放。'

segments.en: 'Each page holds a connection for ~53 ms (21 queries). Only a few connections are busy at once.'
segments.zh: '每個頁面會佔住一條連線大約 53 毫秒（21 次查詢）。同時忙碌的連線只有幾條。'
'把流量提高到每秒 200。'

segments.en: 'Now the pool runs dry. Requests line up waiting for a connection, and some give up after 2 s.'
segments.zh: '現在連線池見底了。請求排隊等連線，有些等了 2 秒後放棄。'

segments.en: 'Keep the traffic, but switch the query pattern to JOIN.'
segments.zh: '流量不變，把查詢模式切換成 JOIN。'

segments.en: 'Each request now holds a connection for 5 ms instead of 53. The same pool serves 10× the traffic.'
segments.zh: '現在每個請求只佔住連線 5 毫秒，而不是 53 毫秒。同一個連線池能撐 10 倍的流量。'

segments.en: 'Switch to New connection per request and push traffic to 300.'
segments.zh: '切換到每個請求開新連線，並把流量推到 300。'

segments.en: 'Every page now pays 30 ms to connect, and the spikes go over the database\'s 20-connection limit.'
segments.zh: '現在每個頁面都要花 30 毫秒建立連線，而且尖峰會超過資料庫的 20 條連線上限。'

'沒有連線池'
`連線池：${S.pool} 條中有 ${m.busy} 條使用中`
`已開啟的連線：資料庫上限 ${DB_LIMIT} 條中的 ${m.busy} 條`
'按「播放」開始送出流量。'

segments.en: `✕ FATAL: too many connections. Without a pool, a spike opened more than the database's ${DB_LIMIT}. ${m.err} requests failed in the last 3 s.`
segments.zh: `✕ 致命錯誤：連線太多（too many connections）。沒有連線池時，一次尖峰開了超過資料庫上限的 ${DB_LIMIT} 條。最近 3 秒有 ${m.err} 個請求失敗。`

segments.en: `✕ ${m.err} requests timed out waiting for a connection. All ${S.pool} are busy ${S.joined ? '' : 'running N+1 queries'}.`
segments.zh: `✕ 有 ${m.err} 個請求在等待連線時逾時。${S.pool} 條連線全都${S.joined ? '在忙' : '忙著跑 N+1 查詢'}。`

segments.en: `⚠ All ${S.pool} connections busy: ${m.wait} requests waiting their turn.`
segments.zh: `⚠ ${S.pool} 條連線全部忙碌：有 ${m.wait} 個請求在排隊等。`

segments.en: `✓ Healthy: a connection is free whenever a request needs one. Each page holds one for ~${X.fmt(holdMs(S))} ms.`
segments.zh: `✓ 健康：請求需要連線時隨時都有空閒的。每個頁面大約佔住一條連線 ${X.fmt(holdMs(S))} 毫秒。`
'JOIN（1 次查詢）'
'連線池（重複使用）'
'每個請求開新連線'

segments.en: '// ✕ N+1: 1 query for the list…'
segments.zh: '// ✕ N+1：清單 1 次查詢……'

segments.en: ' c.venue = await db.venue.findUnique({ where: { id: c.venueId } });'
'// ✓ 2 queries, no matter how many concerts'
segments.zh: '// ✓ 不管幾場演唱會，都只要 2 次查詢'

segments.en: '# .env: the pool lives in the connection string'
segments.zh: '# .env：連線池設定寫在連線字串裡'

segments.en: 'One query fetches the concerts. Nothing wrong yet.'
segments.zh: '一次查詢抓出所有演唱會。到這裡都還沒問題。'

segments.en: 'An await on a query inside a loop: one round trip per concert. With lazy-loading ORMs, it can even hide inside a template that just prints c.venue.name.'
segments.zh: '在迴圈裡對查詢 await：每場演唱會一次來回。使用延遲載入的 ORM 時，它甚至會藏在只是印出 c.venue.name 的樣板裡。'
'預先載入'

segments.en: 'include tells the ORM to fetch all the venues in one extra query (WHERE id IN (…)). Django calls it select_related, Rails calls it includes.'
segments.zh: 'include 告訴 ORM 用一次額外查詢（WHERE id IN (…)）抓出所有場館。Django 叫它 select_related，Rails 叫它 includes。'
'一個應用程式，一個連線池'

segments.en: 'The app opens its connections once at startup and keeps them. Every request borrows from this set.'
segments.zh: '應用程式在啟動時就把連線開好並保留著。每個請求都從這組連線裡借用。'
'連線池設定'

segments.en: 'connection_limit=10 is the pool size from the lab. pool_timeout=2 is how long a request waits for a free connection before failing (the timeouts you saw).'
segments.zh: 'connection_limit=10 就是實驗室裡的連線池大小。pool_timeout=2 是請求在失敗前等待空閒連線的時間（你看到的那些逾時）。'

segments.en: 'The query log for one page shows 1 query on orders followed by 50 nearly identical queries on users. What\'s going on?'
segments.zh: '某個頁面的查詢紀錄顯示：先對 orders 查詢 1 次，接著對 users 做了 50 次幾乎一模一樣的查詢。發生什麼事？'

segments.en: 'An N+1: the code loads each order\'s user one at a time'
segments.zh: 'N+1：程式碼一次載入一筆訂單的使用者'

segments.en: 'The give-away pattern: one list query, then one query per row. Eager-load users or JOIN them.'
segments.zh: '一看就知道的模式：一次清單查詢，接著每一列一次查詢。改成預先載入 users，或用 JOIN。'

segments.en: 'The database is retrying a failed query'
segments.zh: '資料庫在重試失敗的查詢'

segments.en: 'Retries would repeat the same query. These differ only by the id. That\'s a loop.'
segments.zh: '重試會重複同一條查詢。這些查詢只有 id 不同，那是迴圈。'

segments.en: 'It\'s normal: ORMs always run one query per row'
segments.zh: '很正常：ORM 本來就每一列查一次'

segments.en: 'Only when you let them lazy-load. Every ORM has a way to fetch related rows in bulk.'
segments.zh: '只有在你讓它延遲載入時才會。每個 ORM 都有批次抓取相關資料的方法。'

segments.en: 'At peak, Encore logs “timed out waiting for a connection from the pool”. The database CPU is at 15%. What\'s the best first step?'
segments.zh: '尖峰時 Encore 的日誌出現「等待連線池的連線逾時」，資料庫 CPU 只有 15%。最好的第一步是什麼？'
'把連線池調到 500'

segments.en: 'The database only allows so many connections, and each app server has its own pool. It also hides the real problem.'
segments.zh: '資料庫只允許這麼多連線，而且每台應用伺服器都有自己的連線池。這樣也會把真正的問題藏起來。'

segments.en: 'Find what holds connections for a long time (slow or N+1 queries) and fix it'
segments.zh: '找出長時間佔住連線的東西（慢查詢或 N+1），把它修好'

segments.en: 'Low database CPU with an exhausted pool means connections are mostly being held, not used. Shorter holds free the pool.'
segments.zh: '資料庫 CPU 很低、連線池卻用光，代表連線大多是被佔住，而不是在使用。縮短佔用時間就能釋放連線池。'

segments.en: 'Turn off pooling so each request opens its own connection'
segments.zh: '關掉連線池，讓每個請求自己開連線'

segments.en: 'That makes every request slower, and spikes hit the database\'s connection limit instead.'
segments.zh: '這會讓每個請求都變慢，而且尖峰會改成撞上資料庫的連線上限。'

segments.en: 'Encore runs 6 app servers, each with a pool of 10. The database allows 50 connections. What happens at peak?'
segments.zh: 'Encore 跑 6 台應用伺服器，每台的連線池是 10。資料庫允許 50 條連線。尖峰時會怎樣？'
'沒事：連線池是所有伺服器共用的'

segments.en: 'Each server process has its own pool. 6 × 10 = 60 connections can be requested.'
segments.zh: '每個伺服器行程都有自己的連線池。總共可能要求 6 × 10 = 60 條連線。'

segments.en: 'Up to 60 connections are requested, so some fail against the 50 limit'
segments.zh: '最多會要求 60 條連線，所以有些會因為 50 條的上限而失敗'

segments.en: 'Size pools so that servers × pool size stays under the database limit, or put a shared pooler (like PgBouncer) in front.'
segments.zh: '設定連線池大小時，要讓「伺服器數 × 連線池大小」低於資料庫上限，或在前面放一個共用的連線池代理（例如 PgBouncer）。'
'資料庫會自動把多出來的 10 條排隊'

segments.en: 'Most databases refuse connections over the limit with an error rather than queueing them.'
segments.zh: '大多數資料庫會直接以錯誤拒絕超過上限的連線，而不是排隊。'
